property_summary: For every call to the contract's fallback, the reference C only accepts (does not revert) when msg.value == 10 ether, so pastBlockTime can only be updated by calls sending exactly 10 ether; the mutant accepts 1 ether so it will accept some values that the reference rejects, breaking the universal rule.
change_summary: Change the required msg.value from 10 ether to 1 ether, allowing different calls to pass and thus altering pastBlockTime updates and potential transfers.
